rival.challenge.0.speaker: Rival
rival.challenge.0.text: Let us see which of us is stronger!

rival.challenge.1.speaker: Rival
rival.challenge.1.text: Still going? I have been training too!

rival.challenge.2.speaker: Rival
rival.challenge.2.text: I will not fall behind you!

rival.challenge.3.speaker: Rival
rival.challenge.3.text: My team is stronger than ever!

rival.challenge.4.speaker: Rival
rival.challenge.4.text: This is where I pull ahead!

rival.challenge.5.speaker: Rival
rival.challenge.5.text: The Elite Four wait for no one. Neither will I!

rival.win.0.speaker: Rival
rival.win.0.context: Rival result screen after the player wins, meeting 1
rival.win.0.text: Not bad... but I will win next time!

rival.win.1.speaker: Rival
rival.win.1.context: Rival result screen after the player wins, meeting 2
rival.win.1.text: You got lucky. I will get stronger!

rival.win.2.speaker: Rival
rival.win.2.context: Rival result screen after the player wins, meeting 3
rival.win.2.text: Hm. You are good. Very good.

rival.win.3.speaker: Rival
rival.win.3.context: Rival result screen after the player wins, meeting 4
rival.win.3.text: Tch... next time, I will not lose.

rival.win.4.speaker: Rival
rival.win.4.context: Rival result screen after the player wins, meeting 5

rival.win.5.speaker: Rival
rival.win.5.context: Rival result screen after the player wins, meeting 6
rival.win.5.text: You have earned your place. Go on!

rival.lose.0.speaker: Rival

rival.lose.1.speaker: Rival
rival.lose.1.context: Rival result screen after the player loses, meeting 2
rival.lose.1.text: I told you I was getting stronger!

rival.lose.2.speaker: Rival
rival.lose.2.context: Rival result screen after the player loses, meeting 3
rival.lose.2.text: You are not ready for this.

rival.lose.3.speaker: Rival
rival.lose.3.context: Rival result screen after the player loses, meeting 4
rival.lose.3.text: Too easy! Come back when you are stronger.

rival.lose.4.speaker: Rival
rival.lose.4.context: Rival result screen after the player loses, meeting 5
rival.lose.4.text: The champion road ends here for you.
